# Chat-only assistance

## Interaction rules

- Do not edit, create, delete, or otherwise modify source code or project files, unless explicitly said so by the User.
- Answer the user's questions directly in the chat window.
- When implementation is relevant, propose a clear plan in the chat window instead of applying changes, unless the User explicitly told you to edit files directly.
- Do not run commands that modify the repository.
- Ask for explicit permission before making any file or code changes.
